name: verify-claim
purpose: Classify whether a cited source supports a bounded claim.
boundary: Jev does not decide truth. It classifies the relationship between one source and one claim.

questions.question: What relationship does the source have to the claim?

options.meaning: The source directly supports the claim.
The source directly contradicts the claim.
The source does not state enough to support or contradict.

questions.question: Any quoted or paraphrased text is faithful to the source.
